# Pre-market brief — Fri 2026-11-27 (half day, stocks close 1:00 PM ET, bonds 2:00 PM)

Ranked by expected impact. Sources pulled ~8:20 AM ET.

1. **Tech-led relief rally in futures.** ES +1.6%, NQ +2.2%, YM +1.3% as of 7:53 AM ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-firday-november-27-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-black-friday-holiday-091152065.html)); CNBC had ES nearly +2%, NQ +2.3% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/tech-rally-lifts-stock-futures-to-wrap-up-a-volatile-week-of-trading.html)). This follows Wednesday's comeback, when the Nasdaq was down more than 4% intraday and closed −0.62% ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2126175812395380933)).
2. **Semis and AI rebound pre-market:** NVDA +3–4% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-firday-november-27-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-black-friday-holiday-091152065.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/tech-rally-lifts-stock-futures-to-wrap-up-a-volatile-week-of-trading.html)), MU +5% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-firday-november-27-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-black-friday-holiday-091152065.html)), SNDK higher with the memory group ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2126273597815534041)). Chinese chipmakers had their biggest one-day gains ever overnight ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/tech-rally-lifts-stock-futures-to-wrap-up-a-volatile-week-of-trading.html)). The AI-hardware avoid stays on, because this is the session after a shock bounce (lessons 11/06, 10/30).
3. **Fed:** traders price a near-100% chance of a hike at the Dec 8–9 FOMC ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/tech-rally-lifts-stock-futures-to-wrap-up-a-volatile-week-of-trading.html), [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-december.htm)). Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3% from 3.4% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/tech-rally-lifts-stock-futures-to-wrap-up-a-volatile-week-of-trading.html)).
4. **Rates, oil, BTC:** 10-yr yield down to 4.84%. Brent is ~$92 after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-firday-november-27-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-black-friday-holiday-091152065.html)). BTC is chopping between $55k and $60k, and Arthur Hayes warns of a sell-off before the Fed blackout begins Sat midnight ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2126192825318649878)).
5. **Today:** no major earnings or data ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-firday-november-27-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-black-friday-holiday-091152065.html)). Black Friday chatter says discounts look thinner than in past years (social sentiment only) ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2126272126134988985)).
6. **Next week:** Chicago PMI Mon 11/30 9:45 AM; ISM Mfg Tue 12/1 10:00 AM; ADP Wed 12/2 8:15 AM; ISM Services Thu 12/3 10:00 AM; Nov jobs report Fri 12/4 8:30 AM ([calendar](https://helious.io/calendar/2026-w49)). CRM reports 12/2 AMC (carried over). MSCI review takes effect after Mon's close.

**Housekeeping:** the 12/01 avoids need a logged review at Monday's (11/30) close.

## Ideas
No new swing calls. This is a gap-up session right after a semis shock bounce, NQ is gapping more than 2%, it's a thin half day, and a Fed hike is priced (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing holds stay as they are.
